platformRuntime.verification: Windows WinVerifyTrust checks Authenticode chain/revocation and CryptQueryObject identifies the signer; exact SHA256 and fixed product/file versions must equal the approved objects. The independent package verifier matches the same bytes and original terms.
platformRuntime.notice: Microsoft Visual C++ compiler-runtime DLLs are redistributed unmodified under separate Microsoft terms, retained in licenses/provenance/microsoft-community-2026.docx and microsoft-vc14-runtime.docx. The Community Distributable Code grant and official redist list authorize the distributor; the runtime end-user terms alone are not a redistribution grant. Vendor restrictions apply only to the listed Microsoft DLLs. ArcForges source retains AGPL-3.0-only rights. These narrow compiler System Libraries do not authorize other proprietary implementation reuse.
